scientific_controls.canonical_density_basis: supplied g/mol masses divided by volume with exact SI Avogadro constant
scientific_controls.runtime_box_guard: fix halt every minimization/integration step; explicit Boolean axis checks, hard error if any box length <= 2*cutoff
scientific_controls.runtime_bond_guard: fix halt every minimization/integration step; hard error if bondmax >= cutoff/3, a sufficient bound keeping every 1-4 endpoint separation within cutoff
scientific_controls.minimization_budget_policy: continue the bounded pilot, retaining the actual stop criterion; no convergence inferred
scientific_controls.ensemble_claim: short preparation stages, not a verified thermodynamic ensemble

engine_plan.thermo_unit_conversion: not_performed; values are raw LAMMPS output
engine_plan.thermo_normalization: not_inferred; inspect the trusted recipe and engine conventions

input_script:
# Periodic assigned OPLS-AA model with explicit finite Ewald settings.
clear
units real
atom_style full
boundary p p p
bond_style harmonic
angle_style harmonic
dihedral_style opls
pair_style lj/cut/coul/long 10
pair_modify mix geometric shift no tail no table 0
dielectric 1.0
special_bonds lj/coul 0.0 0.0 0.5
read_data system.data
kspace_style ewald 1e-8
kspace_modify gewald 0.29999999999999999 kmax/ewald 16 16 16
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes
# Bounded preparation pilot; no automatic equilibrium/density validation.
thermo 10
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density pe etotal ebond eangle edihed evdwl ecoul elong lx ly lz
thermo_modify norm no format float %.17g
variable polychemmd_box_invalid equal "(lx<=20)||(ly<=20)||(lz<=20)"
fix polychemmd_boxguard all halt 1 v_polychemmd_box_invalid != 0 error hard message yes
fix polychemmd_bondguard all halt 1 bondmax >= 3.3333333333333335 error hard message yes
min_style cg
min_modify dmax 0.1
print "POLYCHEMMD_MINIMIZE_BEGIN"
minimize 1e-6 1e-6 200 1000
print "POLYCHEMMD_MINIMIZE_END"
unfix polychemmd_boxguard
unfix polychemmd_bondguard
reset_timestep 0
fix polychemmd_boxguard all halt 1 v_polychemmd_box_invalid != 0 error hard message yes
fix polychemmd_bondguard all halt 1 bondmax >= 3.3333333333333335 error hard message yes
timestep 0.25
velocity all create 300 49217 mom yes rot yes dist gaussian
fix polychemmd_nvt all nvt temp 300 300 100.0
print "POLYCHEMMD_NVT_BEGIN"
run 100
print "POLYCHEMMD_NVT_END"
unfix polychemmd_nvt
fix polychemmd_npt all npt temp 300 300 100.0 iso 0.98692326671601283 0.98692326671601283 1000.0
print "POLYCHEMMD_NPT_BEGIN"
run 100
print "POLYCHEMMD_NPT_END"
unfix polychemmd_npt
unfix polychemmd_boxguard
unfix polychemmd_bondguard
write_data prepared.data
write_dump all custom final.dump id mol q x y z ix iy iz fx fy fz modify sort id format float %.17g
print "POLYCHEMMD_RUN_COMPLETE"
